Class Asteroid

java.lang.Object
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.Asteroid
public class Asteroid extends Object
A single asteroid that travels left and can bounce vertically.

    • Asteroid

      public Asteroid(BufferedImage image, double x, double y, double velocityX, double velocityY)
      Creates a standard-size asteroid with no collision grace period.
      Parameters:
      image - asteroid sprite
      x - initial horizontal position
      y - initial vertical position
      velocityX - horizontal velocity in pixels per second
      velocityY - vertical velocity in pixels per second

    • Asteroid

      public Asteroid(BufferedImage image, double x, double y, double velocityX, double velocityY, int diameter, double asteroidCollisionGraceSeconds)
      Creates an asteroid with an explicit diameter and collision grace period.
      Parameters:
      image - asteroid sprite
      x - initial horizontal position
      y - initial vertical position
      velocityX - horizontal velocity in pixels per second
      velocityY - vertical velocity in pixels per second
      diameter - rendered diameter in pixels
      asteroidCollisionGraceSeconds - delay before asteroid collisions apply
